name: Heavenly Bodies
source:
Heavenly Bodies is a short visual novel where you play Earth and date other planets.

It's short, cheesy, and full of planets smoochin' each other. 

[From [url=https://thelittleoddling.itch.io/heavenly-bodies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Heavenly Bodies》是一部短篇视觉小说，你将扮演地球，与其他行星约会。

它篇幅短小，桥段老套，到处都是相互亲吻的行星。

[摘自[url=https://thelittleoddling.itch.io/heavenly-bodies]itch.io[/url]]
